allowedResources: A Python 3.12 environment with the pinned packages in starter/requirements.txt (pydantic and pytest), set up before the timed work; no database, network or AI service is needed
Any further resource rule (course pages, documentation, notes) is set and shown by the platform assessment owner
instructions: Final Assessment coding challenge, Python (basic, 10 minutes from the end of setup, reading included). Write validate(records) in starter/settlement/extract.py: check each raw record with the provided Pydantic Transaction model and return (accepted, rejected), keeping input order, reporting each rejected record's txn_id (or None) and the sorted field names from its ValidationError, and looping over the records once. Run python -m pytest -q; the score is the share of the 7 checks that pass, pass mark 70%.
